lead.titleZh: 观察研究提示农村老年人认知衰弱状态转变及预测因素
lead.titleEn: Observational Study on Cognitive Frailty Transitions and Predictors in Rural Older Adults
lead.paragraphZh: 今日有 6 篇文章，覆盖 4 个专业方向。最值得关注的是一项来自《BMC Geriatrics》的观察研究，它以 80 分的 curatedScore 探讨了农村老年人认知衰弱状态的转变及其预测因素。另有两项观察研究得分 75，分别涉及步态不对称自我评估和非处方止痛药对脑震荡恢复的影响。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's digest includes 6 articles across 4 specialties. The most notable is an observational study from BMC Geriatrics, with a curatedScore of 80, examining transitions and predictive factors of cognitive frailty states in rural older adults. Two other observational studies, both scoring 75, explore self-evaluation of gait asymmetry and the impact of OTC analgesics on concussion recovery.

items.title: An exploration of self-evaluation of induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry in neurotypical young adults.
items.summary: A study in 33 neurotypical adults found that self-evaluation of temporal gait asymmetry was more accurate than spatial asymmetry (OR = 0.09 [0.02, 0.51] for presence) and directing attention to the swing phase improved temporal asymmetry self-evaluation (OR = 0.13 [0.04, 0.40]).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对神经典型成年人的初步研究提示，在卒中后步态不对称的康复中，患者对时间不对称的自我评估可能比空间不对称更准确，并且将注意力集中在摆动相可能提高评估准确性。
items.titleZh: 神经典型青年人诱导时间与空间步态不对称自我评估的探索
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 33 名神经典型成年人的研究发现，对时间性步态不对称的自我评估比空间性不对称更准确（存在性 OR = 0.09 [0.02, 0.51]），且将注意力集中于摆动相能提高时间性不对称的自我评估准确性（OR = 0.13 [0.04, 0.40]）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study in neurotypical adults suggests that in post-stroke gait asymmetry rehabilitation, patients' self-evaluation of temporal asymmetry may be more accurate than spatial asymmetry, and focusing attention on the swing phase could improve assessment accuracy.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量较小（33 名），且仅针对神经典型成年人，其结果外推至卒中患者需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (33 participants) and was conducted only on neurotypical adults, so its findings should be generalized to stroke patients with caution.

items.title: OTC analgesic use was associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play (aHR 1.
items.summary: OTC analgesic use was associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play (aHR 1.25, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.39) and lower 3-day postinjury SCAT3 symptom severity (aHR=0.70, 95% CI 0.62 to 0.79) in NCAA and non-NCAA athletes post-concussion.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，非处方止痛药（尤其是对乙酰氨基酚）与脑震荡症状的改善和更快的恢复相关。下次面对脑震荡患者时，可以将此纳入你的症状管理考量，但要留意观察性研究的局限性。
items.titleZh: 非处方止痛药改善脑震荡后症状和恢复：脑震荡评估、研究与教育（CARE）联盟的发现
items.summaryZh: 研究显示，非处方止痛药（OTC）使用与运动员脑震荡后恢复至无限制训练（aHR 1.25）和3天后SCAT3症状减轻（aHR=0.70）呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that OTC analgesics (especially acetaminophen) are associated with improved concussion symptoms and faster recovery. Consider this for symptom management in concussion patients, but be mindful of the limitations of observational research.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性队列研究，可能存在混杂因素，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational cohort study, which may have confounding factors and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Transitions and predictive factors of cognitive frailty states in rural older adults: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study of 3,243 rural older adults from China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study found cognitive frailty (CF) to be reversible, with the intensity of recovery from reversible CF (RCF) to only non-dementia cognitive impairment (NDCI) being 0.429 (95% CI 0.359–0.512), highlighting early RCF as a key intervention window.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型队列研究首次明确了农村老年人认知衰弱的可逆性，并识别出早期RCF状态为关键干预窗口。这为你针对农村老年患者的早期筛查和可调节因素管理提供了坚实的证据基础，尤其是针对RCF状态的干预，能有效逆转认知衰弱并预防不良结局。
items.titleZh: 农村老年人认知衰弱状态的转变及预测因素：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对3,243名中国农村老年人的前瞻性队列研究发现，认知衰弱（CF）是可逆的，可逆性CF（RCF）恢复到非痴呆认知障碍（NDCI）的强度为0.429（95% CI 0.359–0.512），强调早期RCF是关键干预窗口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cohort study is the first to clearly establish the reversible nature of cognitive frailty in rural older adults and identifies the early RCF state as a critical intervention window. This provides a strong evidence base for your early screening and management of modifiable factors in rural older patients, particularly for RCF interventions, to effectively reverse cognitive frailty and prevent adverse outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究人群为中国农村老年人，结果可能不完全适用于其他地域和文化背景。
items.limitationEn: The study population consists of rural older adults in China, and the results may not be fully generalizable to other geographical and cultural contexts.

items.title: How to ensure the implementability of multi-component interventions to improve active ageing in older people? An overview of the evidence of systematic reviews
items.summary: An overview of eight systematic reviews identified a gap between the use of implementation frameworks and consistent reporting of implementation outcomes in multi-component interventions for active aging, with acceptability consistently reported but appropriateness and feasibility least frequently evaluated.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述的综述强调了在促进老年人积极老龄化的多组分干预中，实施框架应用与报告实施结果之间存在差距。这提示你在评估相关干预措施时，要更批判性地审视其实施的可行性、适宜性和可持续性数据。
items.titleZh: 如何确保改善老年人积极老龄化的多组分干预措施的可实施性？系统综述证据概述
items.summaryZh: 八项系统综述的概述发现，在促进老年人积极老龄化的多组分干预中，实施框架的应用与实施结果的报告存在差距；可接受性常被报告，但适宜性和可行性评估最少。
items.curatedReasonEn: This overview of reviews highlights a gap between the use of implementation frameworks and the reporting of implementation outcomes in multi-component interventions for active aging. This suggests a need to critically examine the feasibility, appropriateness, and sustainability data when evaluating such interventions.
items.limitation: 纳入的系统综述数量较少，且实施框架应用和结果报告存在异质性，可能限制结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included systematic reviews and the heterogeneity in implementation framework application and outcome reporting may limit the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: APTA Magazine: October/November 2026
items.summary: The October/November 2026 issue of APTA Magazine features articles on new payment models, a PT-led frailty pilot program, and updated guidance for total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation, focusing on functional gains and digital care.
items.curatedReason: 本期 APTA 杂志探讨了新的支付模式、PT 主导的衰弱试点项目以及全膝关节置换术康复指南的更新。这些内容将直接影响你的执业策略和临床实践，特别是在价值导向护理和 TKA 康复管理方面。
items.titleZh: APTA 杂志：2026 年 10 月/11 月
items.summaryZh: 2026年10月/11月《APTA杂志》刊登了关于新型支付模式、PT主导的衰弱试点项目以及全膝关节置换术康复指南更新的文章，强调功能改善和数字化护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This issue of APTA Magazine discusses new payment models, a PT-led frailty pilot, and updated guidelines for total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation. This content will directly impact your practice strategies and clinical practice, particularly in value-based care and TKA rehab management.

items.title: President's Note | Choosing What Matters
items.summary: The APTA President's note discusses the profession's responsibility to prioritize and adapt to emerging research, technologies, and payment models to make a meaningful difference for patients and communities.
items.curatedReason: 作为物理治疗师，我们需要主动适应新的研究、技术和支付模式，从而在患者和社区中发挥更大的作用。APTA 主席的这篇社论提醒我们，专业发展必须兼顾创新与实际效用，才能避免被时代淘汰。
items.titleZh: 主席寄语 | 选择重要的事
items.summaryZh: APTA 主席的寄语强调，在面对新研究、新技术和新支付模式时，物理治疗专业需要审慎选择重点，以对患者和社区产生有意义的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: As physical therapists, we must proactively adapt to new research, technologies, and payment models to make a greater difference for patients and communities. The APTA President's note reminds us that professional development must balance innovation with practical utility to avoid being left behind.
